title: Tiroler Gröstl
description: A traditional Austria dish made with potato, smoked ham, yellow onion, chicken egg. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 18 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Fry the ham and onions in butter, then add the boiled sliced potatoes and let their edges turn golden and crisp.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 10 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
